channel.title: Bloomberg — diagnostic source feed
channel.description: Diagnostic feed grouped by acquisition connector.

item.title: Trump Says Huang Told Him He Regrets Scandal’s Toll on Family
item.description: President Donald Trump said Jensen Huang called him and expressed remorse over what the scandal that led to his resignation as chief executive of Nvidia Corp. had done to his family.
item.dc:creator: Hadriana Lowenkron and John Harney

item.title: Inside Jensen Huang's Final Hours as the CEO of Nvidia
item.description: At the end, Jensen Huang looked broken and shattered, his legendary energy depleted. After weeks spent denying the allegations of infidelity and fighting to remain in his job as Nvidia Corp.’s chief executive officer, his surrender late Wednesday night was unconditional. Huang’s usual take-charge demeanor had evaporated, according to a person familiar with the situation, and he’d started using phrases like “whatever” and “I don’t care.”
item.dc:creator: Drake Bennett and Ian King

item.title: Nvidia May Face Employee Churn, Analyst Says
item.description: Patrick Moorhead, CEO and Chief Analyst at Moor Insights and Strategy, says Nvidia could face months of employee churn as uncertainty lingers over its CEO search. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Samsung Is in Talks to Acquire Data Center Cooling Firm Modine
item.description: Samsung Electronics Co. is in talks to acquire Modine Manufacturing Co., a maker of cooling systems for data centers, according to people familiar with the matter.
item.dc:creator: David Carnevali and Ryan Gould

item.title: Can Huang's Exit Create Chip Competition
item.description: Jensen Huang’s departure from Nvidia is raising questions about whether rivals can chip away at the company’s dominance of the AI semiconductor market. Bloomberg Intelligence analysts Robert Schiffman and Mandeep Singh say demand for AI computing remains strong, but Huang’s exit could create opportunities for Broadcom, AMD, Google and others as customers look for alternatives and potentially push back on Nvidia’s premium pricing. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Why GTA 6 Took 13 Years and $1 Billion to Make
item.description: Grand Theft Auto VI is expected to be one of the biggest entertainment releases in history, and potentially one of the most expensive. Why is there so much riding on the game? (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: What Jensen Huang’s Exit Means for Nvidia
item.description: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia’s CEO after reports of marital infidelity including an affair with a woman the US reportedly suspects is a Chinese spy. His sudden exit leaves the AI giant with an interim CEO while throwing the broader AI market into uncertainty. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Stocks Down as Nvidia CEO Resigns | Closing Bell
item.description: Comprehensive cross-platform coverage of the U.S. market close on Bloomberg Television, Bloomberg Radio, and YouTube with Romaine Bostick, Jess Menton, Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Cisco Raises Forecast as AI Fuels Networking Demand
item.description: Cisco Systems gave a sales forecast for the current quarter that exceeded Wall Street estimates and raised its annual outlook. Woo Jin Ho has more on "Bloomberg The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Wall Street Whistles Past Nvidia Risk to Bet on Wobbly AI Trade
item.description: Wall Street isn’t particularly concerned about the risks to the artificial intelligence trade posed by the ouster of Nvidia Corp.’s long-time Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang over a series of romantic relationships, including one with a suspected Chinese spy.
item.dc:creator: Jeran Wittenstein and Carmen Reinicke

item.title: Cisco Raises Sales Guidance in Sign of AI-Fueled Momentum
item.description: Cisco Systems Inc. gave a sales forecast for the current quarter that exceeded Wall Street estimates and raised its annual outlook, a sign the AI boom continues to fuel demand for its networking equipment.
item.dc:creator: Dina Bass

item.title: Cerebras Delivers Solid Outlook in Bid to Challenge Nvidia
item.description: Cerebras Systems Inc. gave a sales forecast for the current quarter that exceeded analysts’ estimates, signaling that a push to challenge Nvidia Corp. in AI chips is paying off.
item.dc:creator: Ian King

item.title: Nvidia Can Weather Huang's Departure, Ross Gerber Says
item.description: Ross Gerber, co-founder, president and CEO of Gerber Kawasaki Wealth and Investment Management, reacts to the ouster of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and what it means for the future of the company. He speaks on "Bloomberg The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Bill Simmons Canceled ChatGPT Partnership After Fan Backlash
item.description: OpenAI has spent an estimated $11.2 million on podcast ads in the past three months, but not all podcasters want to promote the technology.
item.dc:creator: Ashley Carman

item.title: Nvidia, AI Industry Face Prospect of Future Without Huang
item.description: Bloomberg's Emily Chang said that while Nvidia will survive the ouster of CEO Jensen Huang, questions remain about if it will be able to thrive in the same way without Huang's relationships with global leaders and no predetermined successor. Chang said the national security implications around the company are in the spotlight going forward, as Colette Kress, the interim CEO in the wake of Huang's resignation, also believes that Nvidia should be able to sell the most advanced chips to China. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Microsoft Struggles to Fix Outlook, Copilot, Hours Into Outage
item.description: Microsoft Corp. struggled to restore access to some of its workplace software hours after an outage began, saying users may still fail to connect to products like email and chat services.
item.dc:creator: Matt Day

item.title: ‘Dark Day’: Silicon Valley Mourns Nvidia’s Decision to Oust CEO
item.description: The ouster of Nvidia Corp. Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang has sent shockwaves throughout Silicon Valley, prompting a chorus of venture capitalists and founders to criticize the chipmaker’s decision and express concerns about the broader impact on the industry. Huang was removed by Nvidia’s board of directors, two people familiar with the matter said, after reports of two affairs, including one with a woman suspected of spying for China and another with an employee. item.dc:creator: Rebecca Torrence

item.title: US Probes If Alice Huang Helped Smuggle Super Micro Products
item.description: The Justice Department is probing Alice Huang, the woman US officials suspect as a possible spy targeting the ousted head of Nvidia Corp., over whether entities linked to her were involved in efforts to smuggle products made by Super Micro Computer Inc. to China, according to a person familiar with the matter.
item.dc:creator: Chris Strohm

item.title: Jensen Huang Removed as Nvidia CEO Following Affairs, Board Appoints Kress
item.description: Nvidia Corp. Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang, the preeminent face of the AI infrastructure boom, was ousted from his post after reports of three affairs, including one with a woman suspected of spying for China.
item.dc:creator: Ian King

item.title: Why Nvidia and Jensen Huang Matter So Much to Markets
item.description: It’s not often that news about someone’s extramarital relationships erases hundreds of billions of dollars of value from the stock market. So far, the market capitalization of Nvidia Corp. has fallen by more than a trillion dollars in the wake of revelations that its co-founder Jensen Huang had affairs with one woman suspected of being an asset for Chinese intelligence and another who reported to him.
item.dc:creator: Thomas Pfeiffer, Ingrid Fuary-Wagner and Wendy Pollack
